subject: Human Evolution
title: Slow Sprinters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Slow Sprinters.

hook.text: Usain Bolt tops out at 44 km/h. A house cat can hit 48. We're terrible sprinters for our size.

buildup.text: Bipedal running is mechanically less efficient for bursts than quadrupedal galloping.

discovery.text: Two legs can't alternate as fast as four, limiting top speed in short explosive dashes.

twist.text: But evolution wasn't optimizing for speed. It was optimizing for distance—a marathon, not a sprint.

climax.text: Humans can outrun horses over 50+ km in heat. Endurance, not speed, was our survival weapon.

quiz.question: What locomotion advantage do humans have over most animals?
